description: Stage 2 route R2 (configs/teacher_train300.json training_plan): as train_s2_base.json but the model starts from the S3 checkpoint of the same seed (init_from_run runs/20261003-tag-S3-s{seed}-dev31, the 749-chapter weak-label run, as stage 1 arm A3 did) and is fine-tuned on the 300 teacher chapters (setting T). Same schedule and rules as train_s2_base.json.

arms.T: R2 (teacher labels of the 300 chapters, fine-tuned from the S3 checkpoints)

backbone.download_note: pytorch_model.bin 411,578,458 bytes plus small tokenizer files (about 412 MB); no safetensors in the repo

planned_steps_note: about 1500 windows / 16 = about 94 steps per epoch x 20 epochs = about 1880 planned steps (S3 on 749 chapters planned 1410); dev scored every epoch, patience 6
